name: TEST ONLY: IIci calibration fall-through test (not for real use)
notes: Makes the calibration's VIA1 timer 2 period 0xFFFF ticks (~84 ms) instead of 0x030C
(~1 ms) so that even MAME's 25 MHz 68030 runs the dbf loops past 65536 iterations.
This exercises the fall-through path exactly like a very fast CPU does: with the
saturation patch the stored values must read 0xFFFF; the unpatched ROM stores 0.
